description: Estimate remaining headroom by comparing V2.2 global blend with per-user oracle selection among fixed experts and blend.
notes: Oracle selection is an upper bound, not a deployable method.
oracle_expert chooses the best of M7, R1, and R1-plus per user using test labels.
oracle_all chooses the best of M7, R1, R1-plus, and V2.2 global blend per user using test labels.
